channel.title: Board Game Nights
channel.description: Rules, tips and ideas for easy game nights.

item.title: How to Play Ticket to Ride: Turns, Routes, and Scoring
item.description: The official Ticket to Ride rules in plain words, including the three turn choices, locomotive limits, route points, tickets, and how the game ends.

item.title: Monopoly Rules Most People Get Wrong, According to Hasbro
item.description: Free Parking, auctions, rent, jail, and building rules from Hasbro's official Monopoly instructions, and why the house versions make games drag on.

item.title: Cooperative Board Games Explained Through Pandemic
item.description: How cooperative board games differ from competitive ones, using the official Pandemic rulebook to explain shared win and loss conditions.

item.title: How to Teach Catan in Five Minutes
item.description: A short walkthrough of Catan's core rules, objective, and bonus tiles, based directly on the official CATAN GmbH rulebook.

item.title: How to Teach Codenames in Five Minutes
item.description: A short walkthrough of Codenames' core rules, roles, and win conditions, based directly on the official game description from Czech Games Edition.

item.title: What Official Rulebooks Say About Player Count and Length
item.description: How Codenames, Ticket to Ride, and Sushi Go handle different player counts in their own official rulebooks, useful for planning a game night.
